title: SitaWare-ingested track
description: Published BY bridges/sitaware_bridge.py via protocols.gateway.publish_dual() to {TOPIC_ROOT}/{domain}/{entity}/c2/{aff}/{entity}/{id}/tracks/v1 (domain/aff/entity slugged from the unit's own SIDC by sidc_to_topic()), plus sibling .../proto/tracks/v1 (NormalizedTrack protobuf) and .../sapient/tracks/v1 (BSI Flex 335) views. This schema documents the JSON leg. Consumed by layers/tak_layer.py and layers/sitaware_layer.py, which only forward samples whose key ends /tracks/v1.

_src.description: Fixed source tag identifying this bridge.

uid.description: Unit identifier from the SitaWare record (uid/id/unitId/uuid, first present).

callsign.description: Falls back to uid's own name/label if no distinct callsign field was present.

sidc.description: MIL-STD-2525/APP-6 symbol ID code; drives sidc_to_topic()'s domain/affiliation/entity-type routing and 2525 map symbology. May be empty for an unrecognized symbol.

target_type.description: Derived from the SAME SIDC via entity_type_for_sidc() (aircraft/unit/vessel/satellite) — feeds flex335.py's _classification_for() for the SAPIENT view, which has no notion of SIDC. Deliberately kept alongside sidc rather than replacing it: two different consumers (2525 symbology vs SAPIENT classification), no shared guideline yet on picking one identification scheme, so both exist.

alt_m.description: Omitted (not null) when the source altitude was missing or non-finite.

speed_ms.description: Omitted when the source speed was missing, negative, or non-finite.

heading_deg.description: Normalized into [0, 360). Omitted when the source heading was missing or non-finite.
